divergences.reason: a cycle frequency is stated in Hz or s^-1; an angular frequency is stated in rad.s^-1 and differs from it by 2*pi, so the two carry different meaning.
s^-1 is a wall-integrated arrival rate and m^-2.s^-1 is an areal flux. Whether a wall-integrated rate should be renamed or re-united is settled outside this record.

a material or detector temperature is thermodynamic and stated in K; a plasma kinetic temperature is stated in eV as an energy per particle. The two are different quantities, not two spellings of one.
